import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_24/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all source tables (UNION)
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
target_df['Name'] = target_df['Name'].astype(str)
target_df['Team'] = target_df['Team'].astype(str)
target_df['Position'] = target_df['Position'].astype(str)
target_df['SnapsPlayed'] = target_df['SnapsPlayed'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_24/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
